properties.value: FlatGeobuf validation patch from pinned official source; preserve nominal-version scanner findings and review patch applicability separately.

backport_review.independent_download_and_diff: The complete local patch differs from the exact pinned primary-source patch only in two numeric conversion contexts: preserve released3.6.4 UInt32GetDatum and FLOAT8OID float widening. Security guards and upstream regression changes otherwise match. NEWS is deliberately excluded during application.
mechanisms_reviewed: Validate size prefixes and remaining bytea before FlatBuffers verification/decoding.
Validate variable-length property payload lengths before allocating/copying.
Reject malformed coordinate counts, ring offsets and oversized packed indexes.
Handle NULL input without entering the C decoder.
backport_review.limit: This is pinned-patch and source-mechanism review, not an independent proof of every C/C++ path, all architectures or absence of other vulnerabilities. SQL/unit/regression execution is qualified separately.

bounded_remaining_constraints.assessment: Primary advisory names tools/tiffcrop.c; tiffcrop executable absent in exact image. Raw libtiff record retained; not a package fix.

Six Critical records name specific stream-dependency/server-push or credential-reuse modes; unrestricted library use is not qualified. Disable PROJ network access and keep database unexposed to public network or arbitrary SQL.

Crafted XML/internal-subset parser issue retained. RSS XML parsing in the reviewed application is Python defusedxml, not this DB library. Keep SQL/XML/GML/KML input controlled; no broad parser waiver.
